ModMetaData.name: [LZZD] Mechanitor Resonance: Universal Mech Analysis
ModMetaData.author: lzzd
ModMetaData.description: Gives every mechanoid kind an analysis research project. Mechanoids without gestation recipes stay barred from subcore scanners, but any mechanoid can instead be analyzed non-destructively in the Neural Synchronizer for 200 plasteel and 3 advanced components, taking twice the destructive scan duration.
